header.v: Tiền thanh toán trực tiếp CĐT

query.text:
select top 0 ma_hd, loai_hd2 into #c from dmhd insert into #c select @ma_hd, '1' from dmhd a where ma_hd = @ma_hd insert into #c select _1so_hd, '2' from dmhd a where ma_hd = @ma_hd and exists(select 1 from dmhd where ma_hd = a._1so_hd and loai_hd2 = '2' and ma_hd_me = @ma_hd) insert into #c select _2so_hd, '3' from dmhd a where ma_hd = @ma_hd and exists(select 1 from dmhd where ma_hd = a._2so_hd and loai_hd2 = '3' and ma_hd_me = @ma_hd)
select a.* into #02 from zhdtt02 a where exists(select 1 from #c where ma_hd = a.ma_hd and loai_hd2 in ('2', '3')) select a.* into #d1 from zdmhd1 a where ma_hd = @ma_hd select a.* into #d2 from zdmhd2 a where ma_hd = @ma_hd
update #d1 set ma_hd = (select ma_hd from #c where loai_hd2 = '2') update #d2 set ma_hd = (select ma_hd from #c where loai_hd2 = '3')
select a.ma_hd, a.ma_dot, row_number() over(partition by a.ma_hd order by case when not min(b1.line_nbr) is null then min(b1.line_nbr) when not min(b2.line_nbr) is null then min(b2.line_nbr) else 999999 end, a.ma_dot, a.ngay_tt, a.so_ct, a.ma_ct, a.stt_rec_r00) as xln , sum(t_tt) as t_tt, sum(tt0) as tt0, sum(tt1) as tt1, a.ngay_tt, stt_rec_r00, so_ct, ma_ct , row_number() over(partition by a.ma_hd, a.ma_dot order by a.ngay_tt, a.so_ct, a.ma_ct, a.stt_rec_r00) as xln1 , case when not min(b1.han_tt) is null then min(b1.han_tt) when not min(b2.han_tt) is null then min(b2.han_tt) else null end as han_tt , cast(null as int) ngay_tre_han, cast(0 as bit) as von_tu_co, cast(0 as bit) as von_giai_ngan , sum(a.tt0) * 0 as tt13 into #rs from ( select a.ma_hd, a.ma_dot, 0 as t_tt, tt as tt0, 0 as tt1, ngay_tt, stt_rec_r00, so_ct, ma_ct from #02 a where loai_tt = 0 union all select a.ma_hd, a.ma_dot, 0, 0 as tt0, tt as tt1, ngay_tt, stt_rec_r00, so_ct, ma_ct from #02 a where loai_tt = 1 union all select a.ma_hd, a.ma_dot, tien, 0 as tt0, 0 as tt1, null, '', '', '' from #d1 a union all select a.ma_hd, a.ma_dot, tien, 0 as tt0, 0 as tt1, null, '', '', '' from #d2 a ) a left join #d1 b1 on a.ma_hd = b1.ma_hd and a.ma_dot = b1.ma_dot left join #d2 b2 on a.ma_hd = b2.ma_hd and a.ma_dot = b2.ma_dot group by a.ma_hd, a.ma_dot, a.ngay_tt, stt_rec_r00, so_ct, ma_ct
update #rs set ngay_tre_han = datediff(dy, han_tt, ngay_tt) update #rs set tt13 = t_tt - (tt0 + tt1) where xln1 = 1
declare @xln1 int = 2 while exists(select 1 from #rs where xln1 > @xln1) begin update #rs set tt13 = isnull(b.tt13, 0) - (a.tt0 + a.tt1) from #rs a left join (select * from #rs where xln1 = @xln1 - 1) b on a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd and a.ma_dot = b.ma_dot where a.xln1 = @xln1
set @xln1 = @xln1 + 1 end
select @@fieldExternal from #rs a left join dmhd b on a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd order by b.loai_hd2, a.ma_hd, a.xln
